title: Card Bonus Rate on a Late-Credited Purchase — Finch Circle and Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards
content:
**Schedule.** In a late credit of Finch Circle Loyalty Program points on a missing-points request, the late-credit card bonus rate is 3 points per dollar when the unit was charged to a Marlowe & Finch card whose Marlowe & Finch bonus is 3 points per dollar, 2 when it was charged to a card whose bonus is 2 points per dollar, 1 when it was charged to a card whose bonus is 1 point per dollar, and 0 when the unit was not charged to a Marlowe & Finch card.

Whether the unit was charged to a Marlowe & Finch card, and to which card account, is read from the tender and the card account on the claimed unit's purchase record. The card's Marlowe & Finch bonus (its Finch Circle bonus points per dollar of Marlowe & Finch purchases) is the figure of that card under Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards.

| Tender of the claimed unit | Marlowe & Finch bonus of the card charged | Late-credit card bonus rate (points per dollar) |
|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch card | 3 points per dollar | 3 |
| Marlowe & Finch card | 2 points per dollar | 2 |
| Marlowe & Finch card | 1 point per dollar | 1 |
| Any other tender (cash, a bank card, a gift card) | — | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A unit paid with a Marlowe & Finch card whose Marlowe & Finch bonus is 2 points per dollar carries a rate of 2.
- A unit paid with a debit card from another bank carries a rate of 0.
